say: Who is Mo Salah's statistical twin?
cap: WHO IS MO SALAH'S STATISTICAL TWIN?

say: To find out, I took every Premier League attacker season since 2020. Six hundred and one of them.
cap: TO FIND OUT, I TOOK EVERY PREMIER LEAGUE ATTACKER SEASON SINCE 2020.|twenty-twenty 601|six-hundred-and-one OF THEM.

say: Twenty-three stats each, per ninety minutes, ranked against everyone that season. Goals and expected goals count the most.
cap: 23|twenty-three STATS EACH, PER 90|ninety MINUTES, RANKED AGAINST EVERYONE THAT SEASON. GOALS AND EXPECTED GOALS COUNT THE MOST.

say: Then we measure who's closest to Salah. Two thousand times, shuffling the weights every run.
cap: THEN WE MEASURE WHO'S CLOSEST TO SALAH. 2,000|two-thousand TIMES, SHUFFLING THE WEIGHTS EVERY RUN.

say: And his 24/25 was ridiculous. Twenty-nine goals, eighteen assists. The most goals plus assists per ninety of any attacker that season.
cap: AND HIS 24/25|twenty-four-twenty-five WAS RIDICULOUS. 29|twenty-nine GOALS, 18|eighteen ASSISTS. THE MOST GOALS PLUS ASSISTS PER 90|ninety OF ANY ATTACKER THAT SEASON.

say: Here's the top eight. And unsurprisingly, number one is Salah himself, in 21/22.
cap: HERE'S THE TOP EIGHT. AND UNSURPRISINGLY, NUMBER ONE IS SALAH HIMSELF, IN 21/22.|twenty-one-twenty-two

say: But take out Salah's own seasons, and the closest player is... Harry Kane. A striker.
cap: BUT TAKE OUT SALAH'S OWN SEASONS, AND THE CLOSEST PLAYER IS... HARRY KANE. A STRIKER.

say: Because they shoot the same. Same shots, same shots on target, same expected goals, same big chances made.
cap: BECAUSE THEY SHOOT THE SAME. SAME SHOTS, SAME SHOTS ON TARGET, SAME EXPECTED GOALS, SAME BIG CHANCES MADE.

say: The difference? Salah created way more. And he finished better.
cap: THE DIFFERENCE? SALAH CREATED WAY MORE. AND HE FINISHED BETTER.

say: So who's the most similar winger of the last two seasons? Harvey Barnes, 24/25. In one thousand nine hundred and seventy-four of two thousand runs.
cap: SO WHO'S THE MOST SIMILAR WINGER OF THE LAST TWO SEASONS? HARVEY BARNES, 24/25.|twenty-four-twenty-five IN 1,974|one-thousand-nine-hundred-and-seventy-four OF 2,000|two-thousand RUNS.

say: And this season, after about ten games? Rayan Cherki.
cap: AND THIS SEASON, AFTER ABOUT TEN GAMES? RAYAN CHERKI.

say: Closest in thirteen hundred and seventy-two of two thousand runs.
But they're not the same player. Cherki passes way more. Salah gets far more of the big chances.
cap: BUT THEY'RE NOT THE SAME PLAYER. CHERKI PASSES WAY MORE. SALAH GETS FAR MORE OF THE BIG CHANCES.

say: So Salah's twin is Harry Kane. Right now, it's Cherki. Who should I find the twin of next? Comment below.
cap: SO SALAH'S TWIN IS HARRY KANE. RIGHT NOW, IT'S CHERKI. WHO SHOULD I FIND THE TWIN OF NEXT? COMMENT BELOW.
